title: Mycelial Search: A Graph-Structured Metaheuristic for Continuous Optimisation
abstract: arXiv:2608.23323v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Continuous optimisation methods need to balance sharing information and maintaining alternative search directions. In this paper, we introduce Mycelial Search (Myco), a graph-structured metaheuristic designed around active tips, community-weighted flow, adaptive cord plasticity, and anchor-based injection. Candidate solutions form an evolving spatial graph in which a Louvain partition distinguishes within-community from cross-community information exchange. Adaptive cord plasticity subsequently modifies active tip-to-tip edges according to their alignment with the local flow. An anchor-based injection mechanism supplements the graph-driven tip dynamics. We evaluated Myco on the CEC 2022 single-objective bound-constrained benchmark suite at dimensions $D=10$ and $D=20$, using 30 independent runs per algorithm-function pair. The comparison includes eleven established optimisers from several search families. Myco reaches competitive resul

translated_title: 菌丝搜索：一种用于连续优化的图结构元启发式算法
translated_abstract: 连续优化方法需要在共享信息与维持替代搜索方向之间取得平衡。在本文中，我们引入了菌丝搜索（Myco），这是一种围绕活动尖端、社区加权流、自适应连接可塑性和基于锚点的注入设计的图结构元启发式算法。候选解形成一个演化的空间图，其中Louvain分区区分了社区内与跨社区的信息交换。自适应连接可塑性随后根据活动尖端到尖端边缘与局部流的对齐程度来修改这些边缘。基于锚点的注入机制补充了图驱动的尖端动态。我们在CEC 2022单目标有界约束基准套件上，在维度$D=10$和$D=20$下评估了Myco，每个算法-函数组合使用30次独立运行。比较包括来自多个搜索家族的十一种已建立的优化器。Myco达到了有竞争力的结果。
tldr: 本文提出一种名为菌丝搜索的新型图结构元启发式算法，通过活动尖端、社区加权流、自适应连接可塑性和锚点注入机制，在CEC 2022基准测试上达到有竞争力的优化性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Mycelial Search, a novel graph-structured metaheuristic leveraging active tips, community-weighted flow, adaptive cord plasticity, and anchor-based injection, achieving competitive performance on CEC 2022 benchmarks.
